steps.observation: Work on this for 60 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Three major long-term causes of World War I are:

1. Militarism  
   European powers engaged in an arms race—building up huge armies and navies—which made war both more likely and more destructive.

2. Alliance Systems  
   Rival blocs (the Triple Entente of France, Russia and Britain versus the Triple Alliance of Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy) meant a conflict involving one country could rapidly draw in others.

3. Imperialism  
   Competition for overseas colonies and resources bred distrust and rivalry, especially among the great powers of Europe.
